title.target: When and while: past continuous and past simple
title.en: When and while: past continuous and past simple

ex.t: When I arrived, he was cooking.
ex.ko: 내가 도착했을 때 그는 요리하고 있었어요.

ex.t: While I was sleeping, the phone rang.
When we arrived, it was raining.
ex.ko: 우리가 도착했을 때 비가 오고 있었어요.

ex.t: I fell while I was walking.
I saw a friend while I was waiting for the bus.
I saw an accident in the street.

title.en: when / while with past continuous and past simple

explain.ko: 과거에 진행 중이던 일에는 과거진행형(was / were + -ing)을, 그 중간에 일어난 짧은 일에는 과거형을 씁니다. while은 보통 진행 중인 일 앞에, when은 짧은 일 앞에 씁니다.
explain.en: Use the past continuous (was / were + -ing) for the longer action in progress and the past simple for the shorter event that interrupted it. While usually goes with the longer action; when often goes with the short event.

head: 표현 / Pattern
예 / Example
rows: When I arrived, he was cooking.
While I was sleeping, the phone rang.
What were you doing when the phone rang?

notes.ko: 진행 중인 일 = 과거진행형, 짧은 일 = 과거형.
notes.en: Longer action = past continuous; short event = past simple.

notes.ko: when / while 절이 앞에 오면 쉼표를 찍습니다.
notes.en: Use a comma when the when / while clause comes first.

notes.ko: 두 일이 동시에 진행되면 둘 다 과거진행형: While I was cooking, he was reading.
notes.en: Two actions in progress together both use the past continuous.

practice.q: While I ___ sleeping, the phone rang.
The phone ___ while I was sleeping.

lines.t: What were you doing when the phone rang?

trans.ko: (질문) 전화가 울렸을 때 뭐 하고 있었어요?

lines.t: I saw an accident in the street yesterday.
I was waiting for the bus. Suddenly a car hit a motorbike.

trans.ko:
A: 어제 길에서 사고를 봤어.
B: 정말? 그때 뭐 하고 있었어?
A: 버스를 기다리고 있었어. 갑자기 차가 오토바이와 부딪쳤어.
B: 다친 사람은 없었어?

lines.t: Yesterday morning I was walking in the park. While I was walking, I saw a friend. When we were talking, it suddenly started to rain. We ran home.

trans.ko: 어제 아침에 나는 공원에서 걷고 있었어요. 걷는 동안 친구를 봤어요. 우리가 이야기하고 있을 때 갑자기 비가 오기 시작했어요. 우리는 집으로 달려갔어요.

questions.q: What happened when they were talking?

lines.t: At about three in the afternoon. I was walking.
A blue car went through the red light.

trans.ko:
직원: 사고는 언제 일어났어요?
손님: 오후 3시쯤이었어요. 저는 걷고 있었어요.
직원: 무엇을 봤어요?
손님: 파란 차가 신호를 무시했어요.

questions.q: The accident happened at about ______ in the afternoon

prompt.ko: 과거진행형과 과거형으로 어제 일어난 일을 3문장으로 써 보세요 (when / while 사용).
prompt.en: Write 3 sentences about something that happened yesterday using the past continuous and the past simple (with when / while).

task.model: When I arrived at school, it was raining. While I was waiting for the bus, I saw a friend. Suddenly the rain stopped.

model_trans.ko: 내가 학교에 도착했을 때 비가 오고 있었어요. 버스를 기다리는 동안 친구를 봤어요. 갑자기 비가 그쳤어요.
model_trans.en: When I arrived at school, it was raining. While I was waiting for the bus, I saw a friend. Suddenly the rain stopped.
